business.name: TPCDS 248 仓库地理分布
business.description: 按国家和省州统计仓库数量、覆盖城市数及分组主键范围，保留空分组。global_min_warehouse_sk 为整个 warehouse 维表实际最小主键，每行重复同一全局值，允许后续库存查询直接绑定该值，不按返回行排名选择仓库。无参数、全仓库。

operation.statement:
SELECT
    w_country,                                              
    w_state,                                                
    COUNT(*)                AS warehouse_count,             
    COUNT(DISTINCT w_city)  AS city_count,                  
    MIN(w_warehouse_sk)     AS min_warehouse_sk,            
    MAX(w_warehouse_sk)     AS max_warehouse_sk,            
    (SELECT MIN(w_warehouse_sk) FROM warehouse)
                            AS global_min_warehouse_sk      
FROM warehouse
GROUP BY
    w_country,
    w_state
ORDER BY
    w_country,
    w_state

business.name: TPCDS 248 仓库期间库存快照
business.description: 按仓库及含边界日期范围返回逐日库存快照。支持数量下限和可空类别筛选。数量单位未由来源声明，不作推断。

operation.statement:
SELECT
    dd.d_date                                                       AS snapshot_date,
    
    COUNT(*)                                                        AS sku_record_count,
    
    SUM(CASE WHEN inv.inv_quantity_on_hand > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)  AS nonzero_sku_count,
    
    SUM(CASE WHEN inv.inv_quantity_on_hand = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)  AS zero_sku_count,
    
    SUM(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand)                                   AS total_on_hand
FROM inventory inv
INNER JOIN date_dim dd
    ON inv.inv_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
INNER JOIN item i
    ON inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
WHERE inv.inv_warehouse_sk = ?
  AND dd.d_date >= ?
  AND dd.d_date <= ?
  AND inv.inv_quantity_on_hand >= ?
  AND (? IS NULL OR i.i_category = ?)
GROUP BY dd.d_date
ORDER BY dd.d_date ASC
LIMIT 100
